content:
maria: heads up — kicking off a config-only rollout in the 22:00 change window (PST). Targets: thin routing tweak + per-tenant timeout bump from 4s -> 6s for shortburst tenants. cfg-id: cfg-squeeze-2026-03-21.

deploy-bot: deploy started for cfg-squeeze-2026-03-21 -> env=prod, scope=config-only, plan=staged, stage=1/5. link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/ops/CFG-2026-03-21

kevin: copy. who's owning the rollout? and who will hit rollback if we see client 5xx spike?

maria: i'll own. @kevin you'll lead rollback execution (we agreed on that in last oncall rotation). notify #eng-oncall if we unpin.

carol: quick ask — what metrics to watch for this particular change? suggest: 95th latency, p50 cold-start, kvcache hit rate, per-tenant error-rate, and routing-drop counts.

maria: agreed. primary watch: p95 serving latency (global) and per-tenant errors >0.5% for 10m window triggers review. also watch kvcache.evictions and queue length on serving pods.

kevin: if we need to rollback, plan is: 1) set rollout=abort via deploy-bot 2) pin previous config (cfg-stable-2026-03-18) for affected tenants 3) run quick canary to validate. ETA for rollback ops ~5-10m.

dave: dropping the config snippet here in case we need to reapply quickly:

```
{
  "routing": {"shortburst_weight": 0.92, "fallback_policy": "latency-prioritized"},
  "timeouts": {"shortburst_tenant": 6000},
  "batching": {"min_tokens": 4, "max_batch_ms": 8}
}
```

maria: stage 1 applied to 2% traffic. watching dashboards now :eyes:

deploy-bot: stage 1 complete. rollout=2%. no rollback flags.

carol: small uptick in p95 for one cluster (us-west-1) — +40ms, not sure if transient. error-rate steady.

maria: noted. holding for 10 minutes. if p95 > +100ms or per-tenant error >0.5% for 10m -> rollback.

kevin: i'll be on standby. if we abort, i'll run `deploy-bot abort cfg-squeeze-2026-03-21` then `deploy-bot pin cfg-stable-2026-03-18 --tenants=affected`.

maria: thanks. will post final status after stage 3.

deploy-bot: stage 2 started -> rollout=10%.

maria: stage 2 green so far. no anomalies in p50/p95 outside of expected variance. proceeding to stage 3 in 5m. :thumbsup:
